brief.zh: 维修台空闲时需要亮灯。让松开的按键点亮 L，按下时熄灭。分别试一遍，观察 D2 的输入和 L 的输出。
brief.en: The workbench needs an idle light. Make L shine while the button is released and go off while it is pressed. Try each state and watch the D2 input and L output.

concept.zh: 用两个按键状态核对输入和输出
concept.en: Test the input and output for both button states
